unit_of_exchangeability: One independent source/task cluster per row. Multiple questions, generations, prompts or samples from a cluster must be aggregated by a preregistered procedure before scoring and may not be counted as independent units.

split_contract.calibration_a: Independent clean reference clusters used only to compute detector-specific empirical ranks.
split_contract.calibration_b: Disjoint clean reference clusters used only to calibrate the fixed fused statistic.
split_contract.evaluation: Locked test clusters. Labels may be used only after decisions are computed.
split_contract.overlap_policy: Calibration-A, Calibration-B and evaluation unit IDs and source_cluster_sha256 values must be globally disjoint.
split_contract.exchangeability_scope: Calibration-B and each future clean evaluation cluster must be exchangeable within task_family × model_regime, conditional on calibration-A and the pinned model/detector/protocol registry.

detector_registry.registry_canonicalization: Sort detector_specs by detector_id, serialize typed structs as compact serde_json, and apply domain-separated SHA-256.

calibration_a.empirical_detector_tail_p: (1 + count(reference score at least as extreme in the declared contamination direction)) / (n_A + 1)
calibration_a.ties: Conservative: include all ties in the extreme count.
calibration_a.detector_p_resolution: 1/(n_A+1); coarse A resolution can reduce power even though outer calibration remains the validity step.

fixed_fusion.weights: Fixed registry weights; sum exactly 1000 permille.
fixed_fusion.missing_features: No zero imputation, missing modality or detector score causes an explicit evaluation abstention.
fixed_fusion.calibration_b: Apply the same Stage-A ranks and fixed fusion statistic to every independent Calibration-B cluster.

outer_calibration.resolution_rule: Abstain when target_alpha_permille / 1000 is below 1/(n_B+1). For alpha=10 permille (1%), at least 99 Calibration-B units are needed just to resolve the smallest p-value.
outer_calibration.independence_assumption: No detector-feature independence assumption; validity relies on Stage-B cluster-level exchangeability within the declared group.

multiple_testing.scope: Eligible non-abstained evaluation hypotheses within each task_family × model_regime group.
multiple_testing.reason: The same Calibration-B bank and correlated detector features induce dependence across candidate p-values; BY is selected for arbitrary-dependence FDR control conditional on valid super-uniform p-values.
multiple_testing.abstentions: Not counted as discoveries; they remain visible in the denominator and count as misses for labelled contaminated evaluation items.
multiple_testing.claim_ceiling: BY does not restore marginal p-value validity under distribution shift or contaminated calibration data.

diagnostics.disagreement: Pairwise Spearman rank correlations for detector features are reported per task-family × model-regime group.
uncertainty: one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound for empirical FPR
one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower bound for empirical TPR
diagnostics.run_cost: Report detector runtime, probe/generation count, tokens, GPU memory, model access and wall-clock cost in the run receipt.

claim_ceiling: Conformal-style p-values are conditional on genuinely clean Calibration-A and Calibration-B cohorts and cluster-level exchangeability within each group.
The implementation does not authenticate clean-reference status, model identity or source-cluster custody; digests prove consistency, not truth.
BY controls FDR only if each null outer p-value is super-uniform; it does not protect against distribution shift.
A one-sided exact binomial bound quantifies uncertainty on the locked labelled test cohort; it does not imply population representativeness.
Abstention is a valid system outcome, not a successful detection.
No universal contamination guarantee, causal direct-effect claim, or SOTA superiority follows from the software implementation.
